title: Metal Fabrication Machines — All Products | NovoTech
meta_description: Every machine NovoTech sells in Canada: press brakes, lasers, shears, ironworkers, band saws, plate rollers, tube benders, deburring, rebar and window machinery.
h1: Metal fabrication machines — the full NovoTech range
intro: Thirty-four kinds of machine for sheet metal, plate, structural steel, tube, rebar and window fabrication. Each page has the full specifications in inches and millimetres, photos, videos and a PDF brochure; every machine is supplied with a CSA-approved panel and supported from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.

quote.intro: Not sure which machine fits the work? Describe the parts — material, thickness, length and quantity — and we will recommend the machine and send pricing, delivery and voltage options.
